title: The effect of vitamin E and vitamin C in patients with COVID-19 pneumonia; a randomized controlled clinical trial
abstract: Hospitalized non-severe COVID-19 patients received vitamins C and E plus standard treatment or standard treatment alone. The primary outcome was clinical response; duration of hospitalization was also assessed.
